question: What is the number of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) set by UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**17**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• There are **17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** set by the United Nations as part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
 
• The 17 SDGs were adopted by all United Nations Member States in **2015**.
 
• These goals are a universal call to action to end poverty, protect the planet, and ensure that all people enjoy peace and prosperity by 2030.
 
• The SDGs are integrated, recognizing that action in one area will affect outcomes in others, and that development must balance social, economic, and environmental sustainability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Core Areas of SDGs**

 
 
• The 17 goals are: No Poverty, Zero Hunger, Good Health and Well-being, Quality Education, Gender Equality, Clean Water and Sanitation, Affordable and Clean Energy, Decent Work and Economic Growth, Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure, Reduced Inequality, Sustainable Cities and Communities, Responsible Consumption and Production, Climate Action, Life Below Water, Life on Land, Peace and Justice Strong Institutions, and Partnerships to achieve the Goal.
 
• Each goal has specific targets to be achieved over the next 15 years.
 
 
 
• **Global Commitment**
 
 
• The SDGs are a global agenda, requiring the cooperation of governments, international organizations, and world leaders.
 
• They build on the success of the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs), aiming to address the root causes of poverty and the universal need for development that works for all people.
 
 
 
• **Monitoring and Reporting**
 
 
• Progress towards the SDGs is tracked and reviewed periodically through a set of global indicators approved by the United Nations General Assembly.
 
• National governments are encouraged to develop their own indicators to complement the global ones, considering national circumstances.
 
 
 
• **Challenges and Opportunities**
 
 
• The achievement of the SDGs requires considerable effort and resources, including addressing gaps in financing and ensuring inclusive participation.
 
• It also presents opportunities for innovation, investment in sustainable solutions, and collaboration across sectors and borders.
